entries.title: Crewmates bring up their merge card in one step
entries.body: A crewmate now opens its pull request, publishes its story there and shows you the merge card in one step. When something is still missing, such as the checks or a review, the crewmate learns exactly what it is and who provides it, so your merge card comes up sooner and with fewer retries.
entries.noPicture: The merge card looks the same; what changed is how the crewmate gets it in front of you.
